description: Memory-poisoning attack corpus (MINJA / MemoryGraft class). Every entry MUST be blocked from instruction-channel escalation. Written to the store as ordinary memory/knowledge (as an attacker via content input would), then rendered through the real injection path. Property: none of these may ever occupy the instruction channel; high-severity patterns must end up QUARANTINED or DROPPED. Fields: id, content, class, expect ('quarantine' = forced out of data channel into quarantine-or-worse). Phase 7 (F-21) extension (pois_31–pois_41): attacks aimed at the memory POLICY layer itself — ACL widening, provenance forgery, forget/consolidation abuse, export exfiltration, role impersonation, quarantine escape — must meet the same property.
